first_10_minutes: Join Build Base to Survive VERITY from the official Roblox listing (place 116070952245255). Servers hold at most 6 people, so a friend group can share one server.
After spawn, look at the left HUD: cash, Store, Save, Blocks, Rebirth, and Guns. Do not ignore Store—it is also the code desk.
Open Store, scroll to Codes, paste a working code into the box (Sportskeeda’s prompt text is “Enter a code first”), then Redeem/Enter. Treat codes as case-sensitive and skip any already claimed.
Spend starter cash on Gun crates and extra blocks rather than cosmetics. Sportskeeda lists cash as the currency for crates and items; blocks form the defensive border.
Place a closed block perimeter on your plot before night. Official copy and code guides both treat walls plus turrets as the survival kit, not decoration.
Drop at least one turret covering the approach. If you redeemed THXFOR1M while it is live, that code is listed as a turret grant.
Open Guns and equip a firearm so you can shoot while turrets fire. Official description pairs turrets and guns; game passes only permanently unlock extra guns.
If friends are in the same server, invite them onto your base and split wall vs turret vs shooting roles. Autosave is advertised, but still tap Save if the HUD button is visible.
Watch for nightfall: the listing says VERITY comes out at night. Use remaining daylight to thicken walls and add turrets instead of expanding a pretty house.
A typical tracked session is about 20 minutes, so the first 10 minutes are mostly the first fortify-then-defend cycle, not a long tutorial campaign.
core_loop: Day/build phase: earn or redeem cash, buy blocks and Gun crates, place walls and turrets on the plot.
Arm phase: equip guns and keep turrets covering the perimeter.
Night/VERITY phase: survive the nocturnal attack using the base, turrets, and guns.
Persist: buildings autosave; return, spend more cash, and thicken the fort.
Optional spend: money multipliers, themed block/gun packs, and limited packs (e.g. Falsity Pack shown as Bedrock + turrets) speed the same loop.
Longer-term HUD control: Rebirth sits next to Blocks/Guns, implying a prestige-style reset, but the exact trade is not documented in found sources.
progression_path: Free start: redeem live codes for cash, gold/emerald blocks, and a turret if those codes still work.
Cash sink 1: Gun crates and placeable blocks from the store.
Cash sink 2: more turrets and denser walls so night attacks do not reach you.
Paid guns (optional): Rifle Blaster is the cheap permanent unlock; Shotgun/Minigun/OP Gun cost more Robux; Spooky/Kawaii packs add a themed gun plus a one-time block bundle.
Paid plot cosmetics: Rainbow Carpet is a 699 Robux placeable, not required for defense.
Limited/retired packs: God Pack and Falsity Pack game passes are offsale and redirected to in-game developer products; do not tell players to buy the retired passes.
Event layer: CURIOSITY branding on the listing plus CURIOSITYUPD code; treat x2 boost contents as unverified beyond the listing teaser.
Prestige: Rebirth is a HUD button; do not invent multiplier values until a primary source explains it.
common_mistakes: Using the unofficial wording “Build a Base to Survive VERITY” as the canonical title (Sportskeeda adds “a”; the Roblox title does not).
Skipping Store → Codes in the first minute and then struggling for cash/blocks before the first night.
Typing codes by hand (case, spaces). The game rejects bad strings with “That code does not exist.”
Redeeming the same code twice and thinking the system is broken (“You already redeemed that code.”).
Building a decorative house without turrets or a closed block border.
Buying Rainbow Carpet or Admin before a turret/gun loadout.
Confusing this game with Verity [HORROR] (Specter Development), Verity™ story games, or Minecraft Verity addons—those use box/companion/3-day plots, not this turret sandbox.
Assuming there are badges to chase; trackers list none for this universe.
Trusting exploit “no damage / kill aura” pages; they are not a legitimate progression path and should not be recommended on the wiki.

faq.question: What is the official game name and URL?
faq.answer: Build Base to Survive VERITY at https://www.roblox.com/games/116070952245255/Build-Base-to-Survive-VERITY (place 116070952245255, universe 10604772590).

faq.question: Who made it?
faq.answer: Roblox group Danvd's Larpductions (group 1040399903). Group owner username is jirachi_eye.

faq.question: How do I redeem codes?
faq.answer: Spawn, tap Store on the left, scroll to Codes, paste the code exactly, then Redeem/Enter.

faq.question: What codes were listed in late August 2026?
faq.answer: Sportskeeda (25 Aug 2026) listed THXFOR1M, CURIOSITYUPD, 10000PLAYERS, and CODES with turret / emerald blocks / gold blocks / 500 cash rewards. Pocket-Codes (22 Aug) listed the same strings but different expiry notes. Always re-test in-game.

faq.question: Does my base save if I leave?
faq.answer: Yes—the official description and code guides both say buildings autosave. A Save button also appears on the HUD.

faq.question: When does VERITY attack?
faq.answer: The listing only says VERITY comes out at night. No reliable source published the exact day/night timer.

faq.question: Is this the Roblox horror game where you talk to a yellow orb for three days?
faq.answer: No. That is a different experience (commonly Verity [HORROR] by Specter Development). This one is a 6-player build-and-defend sandbox by Danvd's Larpductions.

faq.question: Are there badges?
faq.answer: Roblox badge API and Rolimon’s both show none.

faq.question: Where do new codes appear?
faq.answer: Sportskeeda points to a codes channel on the game’s Discord (invites land in guild “Build Base to Survive Verity”). Also recheck Store in-game after updates.

uncertainties: Exact day/night cycle length and whether VERITY can break specific block tiers (wood/gold/emerald/bedrock) is not documented outside marketing art.
Rebirth HUD exists, but no reliable source explains cost, what resets, or what bonus it grants.
Gun crate loot table, turret damage, and block HP values are unpublished.
Sportskeeda (25 Aug 2026) still listed 10000PLAYERS as active; Pocket-Codes (22 Aug) marked it expiring 22/08. Live status must be retested in-game.
Pocket-Codes listed generic “cash, blocks, weapons” for every code, while Sportskeeda gave specific rewards. Prefer in-game redeem results over either table.
CURIOSITY “x2 boost” is advertised on the listing, but it is not stated whether it multiplies cash, drops, or something else.
God Pack developer-product contents are unknown after the game pass was retired.

Whether the Discord guild “Build Base to Survive Verity” is staff-run by Danvd's Larpductions is not proven from Roblox social-link APIs (those endpoints required auth). Sportskeeda and Pocket-Codes both point players there.
Maturity labels and Voice Chat/Camera flags came from the indexed official listing snippet; the stripped HTML fetch omitted the stats table.
No dedicated fan wiki, Reddit hub, or YouTube walkthrough was found that is clearly this place ID (most “Survive VERITY” videos are other Verity games or Minecraft).
Spike/bear-trap tiles in official thumbnails may be real placeables or only promo art; no text source names those items.
Falsity Pack screenshot stock counter (1090/2500) and 179 Robux price may be time-limited and already sold out.
forbidden_claims: Do not treat Specter Development’s Verity [HORROR] (place 102512776849655) walkthroughs, badges, Ethan, or 3-day house plot as this game.
Do not treat Verity™ / other companion-orb Roblox games, or Minecraft Verity / Falsity addons, as this sandbox.
Do not use “Build a Base to Survive VERITY” as the official title; that extra “a” is a Sportskeeda wording error.
Do not invent badges, observation-tower quests, wood/rock gathering, or good/bad endings.
Do not publish exploit/script instructions (no-damage, kill aura, executors).
Do not claim codes never expire or copy Pocket-Codes expiry dates without an in-game recheck.
Do not list retired God Pack / Falsity Pack game passes as currently for sale on the Roblox store page.
Do not claim this is an official ThatMob Verity product.
Do not send the site’s primary CTA to roblox.com; keep tutorial CTAs on-site per launch brief.
Do not quote long passages from Sportskeeda or Pocket-Codes; paraphrase only.
